messages:
maya: Preemptive heads-up: I'm going to pin v2.3.1 on a limited canary and enable a conservative backoff policy due to some yesterday's variability. Starting 10% canary in us-east-1 within the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. @ian @tess please ack.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by maya — canary=10% version=v2.3.1 region=us-east-1
```
deploy-id: db-deploy-4267890123
status: scheduled -> in_progress
route: canary(10%)
```

ian: Noted. quick look at metrics: median latency +12ms, p99 up ~40ms in that region. small tail blips (~0.7% requests >1.2s) — linking grafana: https://grafana.local/d/xyz/canary-v2
tess: I'm seeing a short 502 spike on edge-pool-3 around T+2m (3 failures). Small but correlated with a subpool. Suggest hold at 10% and pin region to us-east-1 until we confirm. :eyes:
maya: Good call. Hold at 10% for now. Can we pin traffic and enable backoff? Command I'd run: `redwoodctl rollout pin --version v2.3.1 --regions us-east-1`
raul: I can apply the pin and set a conservative burst backoff. Also will trigger prefix-cache warmup for the new variant. Applying now.
ops-jen: Quick question — any KMS/HSM changes in this release? We had a token rotation last month and want to avoid surprises.
raul: No KMS changes in v2.3.1. Just model weights + small runtime tweak. Pin applied; backoff policy set to sample_prob=0.2 threshold=80ms; cache warmup started.
deploy-bot: Action logged: pin applied by raul at 4267890128. backoff policy updated. cache warmup job queued.
maya: Can QA re-run smoke tests in us-east-1 now? /cc @tess
tess: Running smoke suite... all checks green in us-east-1 (latency + errors normal). 502 spike cleared.
maya: Vote to move to 30%? react with +1/-1.
ian: +1
tess: +1
raul: +1
ops-jen: +1 (monitoring)
maya: Raising to 30%: `redwoodctl rollout adjust --pct 30 --deploy-id db-deploy-4267890123`
deploy-bot: Traffic update queued for deploy-id db-deploy-4267890123. estimated completion ~30s.
deploy-bot: Traffic update completed at 4267890145 — canary now at 30% in us-east-1.
maya: Monitoring for 15m. If tail-latency or 5xx-rate crosses thresholds, we abort and rollback to v2.3.0. Alerts wired to #incidents.
ian: I'll watch p99, 5xx, and kv-cache hit-rate.
ops-jen: I added an alert for auth failures and cfg drift.
maya: Thanks all — will post any anomalies here. If stable after 15m we'll discuss incremental ramp to 50% and regional expansion.
